international.title: Bigfoot enthusiasts hope government’s US sightings files are ‘just the beginning’ of proving the creature real
international.summary: The Forest Service’s work will ‘help normalize’ talk happening ‘for decades’, says ‘wood ape’ conservancy director When the Forest Service, one of the US government’s less sexy departments, quietly posted three documents to its website in mid-October, it was probably hoping to avoid a fuss. It didn’t succeed. The files were about Bigfoot, after all, and their publication sparked interest from around the globe, with Bigfoot enthusiasts hopeful that this could be a key step step in the road to proving the creature is real.
